Try itI, step by step to 8 m/s: the sum grows while the AV is too slow
Goal: see how I gives throttle even when \(e = 0\). P and I (\(K_i = 0.3\)) from the green light. Every 0.05 s:
  • \(e = 8 - v\)
  • the sum grows by \(e \times 0.05\): first step \(0 + 8 \times 0.05 = 0.40\), then \(0.40 + 7.99 \times 0.05 = 0.80\)
  • the pedal follows P + I, the throttle at most 0.75

Click a row (or press Enter on it): a popup explains its numbers.
